method: Every 2 m pack checksum/length/codec/finite sample; every common edge compared. Effective service resolution is not native acquisition resolution or absolute survey accuracy.
limitations: LiDAR survey date varies; pilot acquisition dates not extrapolated.
Negative/nonfinite service samples and a 4 m margin are marked unknown; original files and SHA retained in acquisition receipts.
128 m RGE is an explicit fallback at fine nodata; it is not called 2 m contact.
Quantization <=0.005 m is storage error, not elevation survey error.
